subject.title: fix(cli): one-shot agent --local runs never export OTel diagnostics

question: Should OpenClaw support starting the configured `diagnostics-otel` service for each embedded CLI agent run, with a bounded 10-second shutdown flush, rather than limiting exporter ownership to the Gateway process?
rationale: The implementation is deliberately changing the runtime ownership boundary for a plugin service and the exit-time behavior of existing local CLI workflows; this needs an explicit owner acceptance even though the branch is otherwise focused and tested.

options.title: Accept the scoped CLI lifecycle
options.body: Approve the OTel-only service start and bounded flush after a current-main merge refresh confirms the local and fallback paths remain covered.

options.title: Keep exporters Gateway-only
options.body: Reject the CLI lifecycle expansion and retain the existing behavior if per-command exporter startup is not a supported observability contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the scoped CLI lifecycle
recommendation.body: Approve the OTel-only service start and bounded flush after a current-main merge refresh confirms the local and fallback paths remain covered.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current integration commit that resolves the fallback-path boundary against main and are best placed to confirm the intended runtime contract.
